Initiate gateway payment for an active buy / crypto-buy invoice.

Mirrors center's `POST client/exchange-invoices/:id/initiate`. Returns the
gateway details: ZarinPal redirect `gatewayUrl`/`authority`, or the
blockchain `walletAddress`/`cryptoAmount`/`blockchainNetwork`/`qrCode`/
`expirationTime`. The body (`{sandbox?}`) is optional.

Get a specific transaction

post.description:
Buy in-app currency with fiat (ZarinPal).

Mirrors center's `POST client/exchange/buy` → `ExchangeService.buy`:
only ZarinPal is accepted here (a blockchain method returns
`EXCHANGE_UNSUPPORTED_PAYMENT_METHOD`); crypto purchases use the
separate `/crypto/buy` endpoint. Validates currency types, computes the
pay amount from stable values, and creates an Active invoice +
transaction. Payment is started via the separate `initiate` step.
Returns `{code, transactionToken, transactionId, invoiceId}`.

Buy in-app currency with crypto (blockchain payment methods).

Mirrors center's `POST client/exchange/crypto/buy` →
`ExchangeService.buyCrypto`: only blockchain methods (TON/BSC/Ethereum/
Solana/Polygon) are accepted; ZarinPal returns
`EXCHANGE_UNSUPPORTED_PAYMENT_METHOD`.

Sell a virtual currency for fiat — creates a manual-review request.

Mirrors center's `POST client/exchange/sell` → `ExchangeService.sell`:
validates virtual→fiat and checks the balance but does **not** deduct
here. It creates an Active, review-required invoice (no payment method);
an admin approves/rejects via `POST admin/exchange/invoices/review`,
and the currency is deducted on approval. The fiat destination currency
id is supplied in `paymentInfo.fiatCurrencyId`. Returns
`{code, transactionToken, transactionId, invoiceId}`.

Fire `add()` for the authenticated user on this streak.

Self-reported flow: emits a `user_event` row for each of the streak's
`event_ids` so the action is auditable in the events log, then runs the
streak's `add()` algorithm. In production, the streak's `add()` would be
triggered automatically by a subscriber listening to any of those same
events — this endpoint is the manual entry point used for self-reported
events (e.g. "I'm here today" button) and tests.

Spend one freeze to protect this streak — allowed once per the streak's
cooldown window. Errors `STREAK_NO_FREEZE_AVAILABLE` (no token) or
`STREAK_FREEZE_ALREADY_USED` (already used this window).

Older-messages page used by the maaniject chat for infinite scroll.

AiFunctionInputKind.title: AiFunctionInputKind
AiFunctionInputKind.description:
Kind of input declared on an admin-curated AI function.

- ``file``     → uploaded via multipart, stored in ai_content, passed
                 to the provider as a content id / presigned URL.
- ``text``     → single-line string. Goes into the function's parameter
                 bag at run time, keyed by the input's ``name``.
- ``textarea`` → same as text but renders a multi-line input.
- ``number``   → coerced to ``float`` server-side.
- ``boolean``  → coerced to ``bool``.
- ``select``   → one of a fixed set of values; options live in
                 ``input.metadata.options`` as ``[{value,label}, …]``.

AiFunctionListGroupedSchema.title: AiFunctionListGroupedSchema
AiFunctionListGroupedSchema.description:
Client list response: functions grouped by the model's ``model_type``
(e.g. text-to-image, image-to-video). Empty groups are omitted.

AiFunctionPackDetailSchema.title: AiFunctionPackDetailSchema
AiFunctionPackDetailSchema.description:
``GET /{id}`` response — same as the list shape plus the pack's
member functions in their natural (created-at) order.

AiFunctionVisibility.title: AiFunctionVisibility
AiFunctionVisibility.description:
Who may see/run a client-created ``ai_function``.

Admin/global functions (``owner_user_id IS NULL``) are always treated
as public regardless of this column.

AiModelCatalogDetailSchema.title: AiModelCatalogDetailSchema
AiModelCatalogDetailSchema.description: Detail response — adds the priority-ordered provider links.

admin to write JSON. The runtime treats all values as opaque and
forwards them to the provider verbatim.

AiParameterTemplateSchema.title: AiParameterTemplateSchema

editor as a starting point and then tweaks per-model.

rendering logic, they're just metadata on the content rows.

shared DB exactly (``text`` / ``options``) — the column binds as that
native enum (see ``shared/model.py``), so a mismatched value (the old

QuizV2HintValue.title: QuizV2HintValue
QuizV2HintValue.description: The hint payload — at least one of {text, contentIds} should be set.

QuizV2OptionAnswerItem.title: QuizV2OptionAnswerItem
QuizV2OptionAnswerItem.description: One option in an options-answer payload.

QuizV2ReactionDto.title: QuizV2ReactionDto

QuizV2UserResponseDto.description:

is the rendered text/options payload; `hints` are the user's

app__modules__gamification__realtime__sc.description:
Spec §3. Used both by the public `/rooms` endpoint and by internal
matchmakers calling `RealtimeService.create_room`.
